mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market overheating signal defined as the unemployment rate rising above 4.0% over a 3-month window indicates cooling economic activity that reduces corporate profit growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer spending and housing demand, signaling an impending economic slowdown that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, indicating manufacturing contraction, it signals reduced corporate output capacity and future earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly core inflation rate exceeding 3.5% (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.035) signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.035.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1200.0 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A current retail sales level above 500,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 500,000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and core inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal a monetary policy tightening cycle in response to persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise simultaneously.
